summary: Firebase Crashlytics in place of the framework's CrashLog boot node: same id and capabilities, Crashlytics started in the background.
manualSteps: Firebase is not on a package registry: download com.google.firebase.app-14.1.0.tgz and com.google.firebase.crashlytics-14.1.0.tgz from the official Firebase Unity SDK distribution into Packages/ManualSdk/, and add both as file:ManualSdk/<file>.tgz lines to Packages/manifest.json.
Enable Crashlytics for the app in the Firebase console; GoogleService-Info.plist / google-services.json are the ones pf-firebase-rc already checks.
Create the installer asset (Assets ▸ Create ▸ PrototypeFramework ▸ Crash Reporting ▸ Firebase Crashlytics Installer) and drop it into RootLifetimeScope ▸ SKU game installers in the Master Scene.
Verify on a device: force a test crash, relaunch the app, and check the Crashlytics dashboard (the first report can take a few minutes).
